name: Julian
title: Julian the Apostate
summary: Julian was the Caesar of the West from 355 to 360 and Roman emperor from 361 to 363, as well as a notable philosopher and author in Greek. His rejection of Christianity, and his promotion of Neoplatonic Hellenism and persecution of Christians, caused him to be remembered as Julian the Apostate in the Christian tradition.
notes: Reign: 1 year, 7 months and 23 days. Julian was a prolific writer (letters, polemics, the Caesares). His apostasy earned him the hostility of Christian historians, but he is admired for his learning and military skill. | Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Julian_(emperor)
